operating_notes.text: L&T Energy GreenTech signed a long-term take-or-pay agreement with ITOCHU Corporation to supply 300,000 tonnes of green ammonia per annum from Kandla, Gujarat.
B&F vertical secured significant orders (₹1,000 Cr to ₹2,500 Cr range) including Oberoi Realty residential towers in Gurugram and an automotive proving ground in Haryana.
Incorporated Vyoma.AI Limited as a wholly owned subsidiary for establishing data centres and AI Infra.
Entered B2B industrial electronics space with L&T Electronic Products & Systems (LTEPS), commissioning two manufacturing lines in Coimbatore.
L&T Realty Properties Ltd acquired 100% stake in International Green Scapes Ltd, acquiring 20 acres in Gurugram with 3.6 mn sq ft development potential.
Executed agreement to sell entire shareholding in L&T Metro Rail (Hyderabad) Limited to Hyderabad Metro Rail Limited for ₹1,461.47 crore.
FY2025 ESG rating score awarded by NSE Sustainability Ratings is 58, with a Core ESG rating of 51.
Secured a large order (₹2,500 Cr to ₹5,000 Cr range) from BCGCL for a coal-to-ammonia-nitrate LSTK project in Odisha.
FY26 consolidated order inflows reached a record ₹435,590 crore, up 22% YoY.
M&M business secured its largest-ever domestic metals order from JSW Steel for facilities in Ballari and Paradip.
L&T's Buildings & Factories business won multiple large real estate orders across three Indian states
L&T Energy Hydrocarbon Onshore won a significant order (₹1,000 Cr to ₹2,500 Cr) from BCGCL for Lump Sum Turnkey Package-3 (Ammonia Synthesis Unit) in Odisha.
PT&D business secured Significant EPC orders (₹1,000 Cr to ₹2,500 Cr) for one 380 kV and two 132 kV substations in the Middle East.
L&T partners with France-based Exail for Indian Navy's Unmanned Mine Counter-Measure Suite programme for 12 vessels
L&T GeoStructure secured largest-ever piling order from JSW Utkal Steel for 30 lakh running metres at Paradeep plant
Secured two Ship Repair Facility orders from IWAI for Patna and Varanasi on National Waterway-1
Won order for construction of India's first yacht marina at Mumbai Harbour from Mumbai Port Authority
Secured Limited Notice to Proceed for New Tashkent International Airport project in Uzbekistan.
PAH business secured two Large orders (₹2,500 Cr to ₹5,000 Cr) for Common Central Secretariat buildings 4 and 5 in New Delhi and two office towers in Amaravati.
Secured major Design & Build orders for CP09 and CP10 packages of Dhaka Metro Line 1 in Bangladesh.
Completion of Business Transfer Agreement with Vyoma.AI and sale of L&T Network Services stake extended to March 31, 2027.

timeline.summary: L&T Energy GreenTech signed a long-term take-or-pay partnership with ITOCHU Corporation to supply 300,000 tonnes of green ammonia per annum from Kandla.
L&T's Buildings & Factories business won significant orders including high-rise residential towers for Oberoi Realty in Gurugram and a vehicle proving ground in Haryana.
L&T incorporated Vyoma.AI Limited as a wholly owned subsidiary on April 22, 2026.
Larsen & Toubro entered the B2B industrial electronics segment with the launch of LTEPS and commissioning of manufacturing lines in Coimbatore.
L&T Realty acquired a 100% stake in International Green Scapes Ltd, securing 20 acres of land in Gurugram with 3.6 million square feet of development potential.
Larsen & Toubro executed a Share Purchase Agreement on April 29, 2026, to sell its entire stake in L&T Metro Rail (Hyderabad) Limited to Hyderabad Metro Rail Limited for ₹1,461.47 crore.
NSE Sustainability Ratings awarded Larsen & Toubro an ESG score of 58 and a core ESG rating of 51 for FY2025.
L&T secured a large order from BCGCL on May 5, 2026, for a coal-to-ammonia-nitrate project in Odisha.
L&T reported FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹285,874 crore and order inflows of ₹435,590 crore, with the order book reaching a record ₹740,327 crore.
L&T's Minerals & Metals business secured its largest-ever domestic metals sector order from JSW Steel for expansions in Ballari and Paradip.
2026-05-07: L&T's Buildings & Factories business won multiple large real estate orders across three Indian states
2026-05-11: Larsen & Toubro uploaded the transcript of its Q4FY26 earnings call held on May 5, 2026.
L&T secured 'Significant' orders (₹1,000 Cr to ₹2,500 Cr) for extra-high voltage substations in the Middle East.
2026-05-14: L&T enters strategic collaboration with France-based Exail to deliver Unmanned Mine Counter-Measure Suite for Indian Navy's 12-vessel programme
L&T published its Integrated Annual Report for FY2025-26 on May 14, 2026, reporting consolidated revenue of ₹285,874.36 Cr with an unmodified audit opinion.

2026-05-26: L&T GeoStructure secures multiple orders including largest-ever piling order from JSW Utkal Steel, Ship Repair Facilities from IWAI, and India's first yacht marina from Mumbai Port Authority
L&T assigned an ESG rating score of '53' (adequate) by ESG Risk Assessments & Insights on May 29, 2026

Larsen & Toubro Limited’s 81st AGM on June 5, 2026, approved audited standalone/consolidated financials, ₹38 dividend, and reappointed directors including **R. Shankar Raman** (President & WTD-Finance) and **Anil V Parab** (WTD).
2026-08-03: L&T uploaded the transcript of its Q1FY27 earnings call held on July 28, 2026, to its investor website.
On October 19, 2026, L&T announced securing a Limited Notice to Proceed for the New Tashkent International Airport project in Uzbekistan.
On October 21, 2026, Larsen & Toubro announced winning Large orders (₹2,500 Cr to ₹5,000 Cr) for the Common Central Secretariat in New Delhi and office towers in Amaravati.
L&T secured major design and build orders for two key systems packages of the Dhaka Metro Line 1 project in Bangladesh.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹78,749.94 Cr (+15.8% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹5,202.1 Cr (+32.5% YoY).
L&T reported Q2FY27 consolidated revenue of ₹78,750 Cr and PAT of ₹5,202 Cr, backed by record order inflows.
On October 31, 2026, L&T extended the timeline for the sale of L&T Network Services to its subsidiary Vyoma.AI to March 31, 2027.
